title: 第十七章邪修全城血祭第十八章叶夕瑶战败全城绝望
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: “队长还真是智慧无双，献祭全城的血气要是全都制造血灵石的话，说不定您就可以突破真正的元婴。”
“到那时，您在万魂宗的地位必然水涨船高，成就那高高在上的人级护法，我们在您手底下做事就可以越发地肆无忌惮了。”
听到小弟的吹捧，血云子满意地笑了笑，整个人都快要癫狂了。
护法职位在万魂宗享有宗门俸禄和大权，类似于宗门长老级别。
分为天、地、人三种等级，其中天级最高仅次于宗门副大长老级别。
别看人级护法等级最低，但在他们眼中已经是天花板的存在。
只要成为护法便可号令像他们这种级别的菜鸟，足足有着数万之多。
这也是他会笑得这么疯狂的原因。
“说得好，只要献祭了这座城，到那时少不了你们的好处。”
很快，三名邪修在盖好了血井，用特殊阵法隐藏这里后，立刻消失在原地。
“从外面看只是一堵平平无奇的墙，只有走到最里面才能看到真实，闻到这浓浓的血腥味。”
“阵法一道博大精深，幻阵真是名不虚传。”
大约过了一个时辰的时间，隐藏在暗处的王麻子才敢现身。
掀起那块黑布，望着那深深的血井，饶是李长寿此刻相隔数十里，看到这血腥场面都忍不住打了个寒颤。
“万魂宗果然心狠手辣，这血井少说死了数万人。”
李长寿攥紧拳头，就连他都开始佩服起他们的老六行为。
这还仅仅只是暗处他侥幸找到的。
天知道这种血井黑风城会有多少。
“不行，不管今天发生什么，哪怕舍去这一道分身。”
“老夫都要看看，出城路到底隐藏着多少邪修。”
在走前，李长寿往血井中投掷了一些不可描述的毒素。
有泻药、催情的还有影响根基逆流灵气的。
虽然只是凡间的毒药，但对筑基修士来说会有不可描述的奇效。
“依靠血灵石修炼，这就当是我为你们准备的第一份大礼了。”
来到城门口，周围风平浪静，李长寿并没有看到任何邪修，但却感受到了浓浓的血腥气。
正当他打算寻找一下他们的位置时，异变突生。
只见三道夺命血刃从他的背后刺了过来，李长寿摆了摆头一指震碎血刃，随后用冷漠的目光看向后方那颗巨石。
巨石后面十几个万魂宗黑袍人从里面跳了出来，对着他包围开来。
“此山是我开此树是我栽，要想从此过就把命留下。”
“还能挡住我的攻击，看来是个高手啊！”
为首的一名黑袍人摇晃着手中的弯刀，舔了舔上面还未干的血渍。
这些血渍是新鲜的，显然是刚刚灭杀了出城之人。
李长寿起初相当警惕，当看穿他们修为，脸上的笑容逐渐变得玩味。
当然，王麻子的马甲是戴面具状态，对方也看不清楚，只能通过眼神来判断表情。
“本座打算出城，你们这是要执意如此了？”
“出城？”为首的邪修冷笑一声：“你的灵魂当然可以出城，我们不拦着，但是你的身体得留下，又或者说我们要你的命。”
筑基修士的精血品质远超那些没有修为的凡人，他们也不可能放眼前之人离开。
“灵魂自由吗？”
“那本座就送你们去见阎王。”
李长寿一步踏出，筑基巅峰的威压横扫而开，紧接着一双巨大的魔手从天而降。
在场的邪修修为最高也才筑基后期，仅是一个照面就被全部镇压。
content_en:
"The captain is truly unparalleled in wisdom. If you sacrifice all the blood in the city to create blood spirit stones, maybe you can break through to the real Nascent Soul."
"By then, your status in the Ten Thousand Souls Sect will inevitably rise, and you will become a human-level protector. We will be able to do things under your hands even more unscrupulously."
Hearing his younger brother's praise, Xueyunzi smiled with satisfaction, almost going crazy.
The position of protector enjoys the sect salary and power in Wanhun Sect, which is similar to the sect elder level.
It is divided into three levels: heaven, earth, and human. Among them, the heaven level is the highest, second only to the sect's deputy elder level.
Even though the human level protector is the lowest, in their eyes it is already the ceiling.
As long as you become a protector, you can command tens of thousands of rookies like them.
That's why he laughs so crazily.
"Well said, as long as this city is sacrificed, your benefits will be indispensable by then."
Soon, after the three evil cultivators built the blood well and hid it with a special formation, they immediately disappeared.
"From the outside, it looks like an ordinary wall. Only when you go inside can you see the reality and smell the strong smell of blood."
"The formation techniques are extensive and profound, and the illusion formation is truly well-deserved."
After about an hour, Wang Mazi, who was hiding in the dark, dared to show up.
Lifting up the black cloth and looking at the deep well of blood, even though Li Changshou was dozens of miles away at the moment, he couldn't help but shudder when he saw the bloody scene.
"The Wanhun Sect is indeed ruthless. It is said that tens of thousands of people died in this Xuejing Shao."
Li Changshou clenched his fists, and even he began to admire their stupid behavior.
This was just something he found by luck in the dark.
God knows how many such bloody wells and black wind cities there are.
"No, no matter what happens today, even if I give up this clone."
"I want to see how many evil cultivators are hidden on the road out of the city."
Before leaving, Li Changshou threw some indescribable poison into the blood well.
There are laxatives, aphrodisiacs, and those that affect the root and reverse the flow of spiritual energy.
Although it is just a mortal poison, it will have indescribable miraculous effects on the foundation-building monks.
"Rely on the Blood Spirit Stone to practice. This is the first gift I have prepared for you."
When he arrived at the city gate, the surroundings were calm. Li Changshou did not see any evil cultivators, but he felt the strong smell of blood.
Just when he was about to find their location, something happened suddenly.
He saw three deadly blood blades stabbing him from behind. Li Changshou shook his head and shattered the blood blades with one finger, then looked at the huge boulder behind him with indifferent eyes.
A dozen men in black robes from the Ten Thousand Souls Sect jumped out from behind the boulder and surrounded him.
"I planted this mountain and planted this tree. If you want to live forever, leave your life behind."
"You can still block my attacks. You seem to be a master!"
The leader, a man in black robe, shook the scimitar in his hand and licked the blood that was still wet on it.
These blood stains were fresh, and it was obvious that they had just killed people who had left the city.
Li Changshou was quite wary at first, but when he saw through their cultivation, the smile on his face gradually turned playful.
Of course, Wang Mazi was wearing a mask, so the other party couldn't see clearly and could only judge his expression through his eyes.
"I plan to leave the city, are you determined to do this?"
"Leave the city?" The leader of the evil cultivators sneered: "Of course your soul can leave the city, we won't stop you, but your body must stay, or we will kill you."
The essence and blood quality of the foundation-building monks is far superior to those of mortals without cultivation, and they cannot let the people in front of them leave.
"Is the soul free?"
"Then I will send you to see the King of Hell."
Li Changshou took one step forward, and the pressure from the peak of Foundation Establishment swept away, followed by a pair of huge demonic hands falling from the sky.
The evil cultivators present were only at the late stage of foundation building, and they were all suppressed after just one encounter.
